problem: What is the average value of $h(x)=\operatorname{sin}⁡2x$ on the interval $[\frac{\pi }{4},\frac{\pi }{2}]?$
worked_solution:
Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{h}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}\,{\int }_{a}^{b}h(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{(\frac{\pi }{2}-\frac{\pi }{4})}\,{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{sin}⁡2x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{4}{\pi }\,{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{sin}⁡2x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{4}{\pi }{(\frac{1}{2})(-\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x))|}_{\pi /4}^{\pi /2} \\  & =-\frac{2}{\pi }[\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{2})-\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{4})] \\  & =-\frac{2}{\pi }[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\pi )-\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})] \\  & =-\frac{2}{\pi }(-1-0) \\  & =\frac{2}{\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$
